_about: Made-up sample terms for a fictional payments team. FILL IN: replace them with your team's terms. Use approved, non-secret definitions only.

terms.the ledger: Our double-entry service. Every payment writes two matching entries here. Owned by the Core team.
terms.T+1: Settlement on the next business day after a payment is made.
terms.recon: Reconciliation: the nightly job that checks our ledger against the bank's statement.
terms.four-eyes rule: Any change to payment logic needs a second reviewer before it ships.
terms.PII: Personally identifiable information, such as names, emails and card numbers. Never paste it into a prompt.
